title: National Doctrines
description: Doctrine research tree: 10 branches, each with 5 tiers of 3 mutually-exclusive doctrine cards, a capstone milestone, 3 alternative directives (post-milestone, cooldown-gated), and a 12-card hidden pool (drawn as hidden_cards_presented options when a branch's hidden trigger fires). legacy_tech_map/legacy_tech_order bridge the retired flat tech_tree.json onto the new branch/tier gate-key space (e.g. 'military_t2') during the transition period. starting_grants seed curated great-power head starts (tier already unlocked at game start, 1-5).

legacy_tech_map.description: Old tech_tree.json node id -> doctrine gate key ('<branch>_t<tier>') it now maps onto. Transition-period lookup only; every value must satisfy the gate-key pattern.

legacy_tech_order.description: The 56 legacy tech_tree.json node ids, in that file's node order. Must exactly match legacy_tech_map's keys (as a set) and tech_tree.json's node order (validated cross-file, not by this schema).

starting_grants.description: Curated head-start unlocks keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Each entry maps branch id -> already-unlocked tier (1-5).

max_concurrent_research.description: How many doctrine tiers a country may research simultaneously.

tier_costs.description: Treasury cost to research tier N (index 0 = T1 .. index 4 = T5), shared by every branch.

tier_research_months.description: Minimum research duration (months) for tier N, shared by every branch — a per-slot pace floor: RP throughput above cost/months is wasted, compressible only via research_floor_max_compression (DoctrineResearchSystem).

hidden_trigger_tiers.description: Tier thresholds (1-based) whose completion in a source branch each generates one hidden opportunity, at most once per (branch, threshold) — canonical [2, 4] (T2/T4 source-trigger model, DoctrineResearchSystem).

hidden_campaign_trigger_cap.description: Campaign-lifetime cap on generated hidden opportunities per country — canonical 5. HARD maximum 5: CountryDoctrineState's banked-trigger source queue has exactly 5 slots (BankedHiddenSource0..4); a larger cap would silently drop source branches past slot 5 (the bake also clamps).

max_hidden_triggers_per_branch.description: Cap on hidden-card triggers a single branch can fire over the game.

hidden_cards_presented.description: How many hidden_pool cards are drawn as a choice when a trigger fires.

directive_switch_cooldown_days.description: Days a country must wait before switching its active branch directive again.

satellite_gate_key.description: Gate key that must be unlocked before satellite/recon features become available.

base_research_speed.description: Baseline doctrine research speed multiplier before education/self-feedback modifiers (DoctrineResearchSystem).

education_research_modifier.description: Scales AvgEducationLevel's contribution to research speed (DoctrineResearchSystem).

research_points_per_billion_gdp.description: Research points generated per sqrt(research budget in billions USD) (DoctrineResearchSystem).

building_research_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to building-sourced research output before it's added to budget-sourced RP (DoctrineResearchSystem).

research_points_base.description: Flat monthly RP every country generates regardless of budget/buildings — keeps micro-states on the doctrine ladder (DoctrineResearchSystem).

research_floor_max_compression.description: Max divisor research-speed tech bonuses can apply to tier_research_months (1 = floors immutable). A tier never completes faster than months / min(1 + research_speed, this) regardless of RP throughput (DoctrineResearchSystem).

diplo_alignment_relation_scale.description: Monthly relation delta per point of (ownDiploAlignment x targetDiploAlignment) doctrine affinity (RelationsSystem) — the doctrine-domain counterpart of political_drift.law_relation_drift_scale, kept in doctrines.json (not game_settings.json) since it only scales CountryDoctrineEffects.DiploAlignment.

id.description: Internal stable branch id (e.g. 'military'). Combines with tier index to form gate keys like 'military_t2'.

doctrine_card.description: One of the 3 mutually-exclusive doctrine choices within a tier.

bloc_stance.description: OPTIONAL political identity (Government/Society/Military tier doctrines only — everything else stays neutral/absent). How each ideology bloc leans on this doctrine: -1 strongly oppose ... +1 strongly support, IdeologyBloc order. Every sub-key is itself optional (omitted = 0/no lean). Feeds ONLY AIDoctrineSystem's political-coherence scoring term (DoctrineFormulas.PoliticalCoherenceScore) — deliberately NOT summed into any CountryDoctrineEffects gameplay lane, NOT a DoctrineLaneKey, and excluded from DoctrineChoiceSetGuardTests' sibling-balance vectors (identity, not power).

diplo_alignment.description: OPTIONAL political identity: position on the diplomatic axis, authoritarian-lean negative ... liberal-lean positive. Sums (clamped to [-1,1] across every active doctrine) into CountryDoctrineEffects.DiploAlignment, which RelationsSystem multiplies pairwise (own x target, scaled by settings.diplo_alignment_relation_scale) alongside national-law affinity. Default 0 (no footprint).

drift_target_bloc.description: OPTIONAL political identity: ideology bloc this doctrine slowly pulls the electorate toward (PromoteBloc math, same mechanism as laws.json's per-option drift). Null/absent = no drift.

drift_monthly.description: OPTIONAL political identity: monthly electorate drift toward drift_target_bloc (share fraction), summed into CountryDoctrineEffects.BlocDriftMonthly alongside active laws' drift (LawEffectSystem). Ceiling is exactly 1/3 of laws.json's drift_monthly ceiling (0.0006 seen in practice) — doctrine picks are PERMANENT, so their electorate pull is authored smaller than a reversible law's. Default 0.

milestone.description: Capstone bonus granted once all 5 tiers of a branch are researched.

directive.description: One of 3 alternative post-milestone stances a branch can switch between (cooldown-gated, directive_switch_cooldown_days). No icon/ai: directives are a pure stance switch, not a drafted card.

hidden_card.description: One of 12 pool cards a branch can surface when its hidden-card trigger fires; hidden_cards_presented of them are offered as a choice.

weight.description: Relative draw weight among the branch's hidden_pool entries when hidden_cards_presented are sampled.

ai_weights.description: AI pick-weighting by strategic lens (e.g. military/economy/stability/intel/diplomacy). Values are relative shares, normally summing to ~1.0. Additional lenses may be added later.

effects.description: Gameplay effect deltas/multipliers applied while a doctrine/milestone/directive/hidden card is active. Property names are restricted to the permitted vocabulary below; a given card may set any subset. Multiplier-style fields (the '_mult' suffix family, plus sovereign_invest_eff which multiplies without the suffix) are ratios centered on 1.0; the 7 listed integer fields are small +/- point deltas; everything else is a small additive fraction.

espionage_damage_mult.description: Phase B (espionage-damage-containment): multiplies steal/sabotage/intel-theft magnitude resolved against this country's espionage/cyber defenses (neutral 1.0).

social_spending_drain.description: Phase B (social-spending-drain): off-discretionary monthly treasury drain, as a fraction of GDP (neutral 0), booked to the FiscalAccumulator.SocialSpendingDrainExpense ledger lane.

decree_resentment_mult.description: Government Laws & Decrees hook: multiplies the ClandestineResentment added by ChangeLawCommand's decree branch (neutral 1.0). Lower is better — still bounded at max(0,·) so opposition resentment always still accumulates.

law_cooldown_mult.description: Government Laws & Decrees hook: multiplies a law category's authored cooldown months at ChangeLawCommand's cooldown gate (neutral 1.0). Lower is better (faster to change laws again).
